content.text: Ia duwe, ke kak apihada Lepaiadan,
de salihkihdi sellap pwoat lowe?
Ke kak kihong sahl pwoat nin tumwe,
de kehs ehu nan ewe?
E kak peki rehmw ke en sapwadala,
de ke en mahkohng?
E kak en inoukihong uhk mehkot,
de inoukihda me e pahn papahiuk kohkohlahte?
Ke kak wiahki ih noumw kisin mehn mwadong kis,
me ke pahn kin kaperenehki serepein kan me kin papahiuk?
Soused kan pahn netki ni pweimwahu?
Sounnetinet kan pahn pwalangpeseng pwe re en netikihla?
Ke kak kadirehkihla kili ketieuwen soused kan,
de doakoahki moange ketieu pwoat?
Song sair pakteieu, a ke solahr pahn pwurehng kohkohlahte;
ke sohte kak manokehla uhpene wet!
Mehmen me kin kilang Lepaiadan,
kin sohla angi oh kin pwupwudiong nanpwel.
Ni mahn menet eh kin kesihnenda, me inenen mas kamasepwehk;
sohte me kin men uhda mwowe.
Ihs me kak uhwong ahpw pitlahsang?
Sohte nin sampah me kak wia met.
I pahn padakihong uhk duwen nehn Lepaiadan,
oh koasoiahda uwen kehlail en paliwere.
Sohte me kak tehrasang kidip en paliwere,
de kauwehkihla kili tehtehn pei.
Ihs me kak kasarapeseng ewe,
me ngih kamasepwehk kei kapilpenehr?
Pohntihnsewe, irek en wunen mwomw kei me wia,
paspene oh kekeluwak duwehte takai.
Ehute pasehng meteio oh keirekpene;
sohte kisinieng kis kak duwal nanpwung.
Koaros inenen patpene oh keirekpene;
sohte mehkot kak kamweidirailpeseng.
Ni eh kin asi, marain kin pirieisang nan tumwe,
oh pwoaren mese kan kin lingaling, rasehng dakedahn ketipin.
Mpwulen kisiniei kin lulsang nan ewe,
rasehng mwoalus mwehl en nan uhmw.
Ediniei kin uh sang nan pwoaren tumwe,
rasehng edin tuwi me lullul pahn einpwoat.
Angin eh esingek kin sounda kisiniei,
mpwulen kisiniei kin uh sang nan ewe.
Eh kehl unsek mihmi nin tepinwere,
masepwehk kin kipehdi koaros me kin tuhwong.
Sohte wasa kis muterek ni kili,
pwe me kekeluwak oh apwal duwehte mete.
Nan eh mohngiong sohte masak kin dierek ie,
pwe me apwal oh kekeluwak duwehte takai.
Ni eh kin pwourda oh uhda, koht akan pil kin masepwehkada,
pwehki ar masak, e kin sohla angirail.
Sohte kedlahs pwoat kak kalipwelipwehda;
sohte ketieu pwoat, de arep pwoat, de lepin seipali, kak kauwehla.
E kin wiahki mete diper en tuhke,
oh prons mehkot kopwukopw reh, rasehng tuhke mwoasoangot.
Sohte kesik keteiu me kak kasalowehda pwe en tangdoaui;
takai kan me pahn koasuk, rasehng diper en dihpw.
E kin wiahki mehn wowoki kan kisin diper en dihpw,
oh e kin kouruhrki ketieu kan me aramas kin doakoahki.
Kapehde rasehng pwoatol ohla kei me keng;
ni eh kin limwahdek, e kin pwalangpeseng pwehl muterek kan rasehng mehn ruwahdek me mete mi pahn kapi.
E kin kamwekidada nansed duwehte einpwoat pwoapwoail ehu,
oh kin kapwudopwudehda duwehte ketel en leh ehu.
Ni eh kin tangatang kohla, lipwe kin wiahda ahl lingaling ehu.
oh e kin kadirehkihla nansed pwudopwud pwetepwet.
Sohte mehkot nin sampah me kak karasarasohng,
pwe mahn emen ih me sohte kin masepwehk.
E pil kin mwamwahliki mahn me keieu lapalap akan,
pwe ih me nanmwarkien mahn lawalo koaros. nan welin ahlek kan nan lepwel kan.
